title: The canonical simultaneous-root diagram over an arbitrary set of positive orders
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\geq0$, $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in R$, and $I\subset\mathbf Z_{>0}$. Endow $I$ with the divisibility preorder and its associated small category. For $n\in I$ let $J_n=(X_d^n-t_d)_{1\leq d\leq r}$ in the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and let $B_n=R[X_1,\ldots,X_r]/J_n$ with its quotient $R$-algebra structure [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. This is the simultaneous parameter-root algebra [def-sfb-parameter-root-algebra], used here for positive exponents, without any characteristic or locality hypothesis. Write $\pi_n$ for the quotient map and $x_{d,n}=\pi_n(X_d)$. For $n\mid m$, the $R$-algebra evaluation $X_d\mapsto x_{d,m}^{m/n}$ kills every element of $J_n$; define $u_{nm}:B_n\to B_m$ by descending this evaluation. These specified maps satisfy $u_{nn}=\operatorname{id}$ and $u_{mk}\circ u_{nm}=u_{nk}$ for $n\mid m\mid k$, and define the functor $D:I\to\mathrm{CRing}$ with $D(n)=B_n$, $D(n\mid m)=u_{nm}$. Its simultaneous-root colimit is the chosen ring colimit $\varinjlim D$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. If $1\in I$, its coefficient map is $R\to B_1\to\varinjlim D$, where the second map is the colimit coprojection. The construction allows $r=0$, zero $R$, and arbitrary $I$; no filteredness, characteristic or invertibility condition is imposed to define it.
